rationale: Seven actionable findings across the new components: one critical data-loss defect (silent duplicate-key collision in InputMappingEditor.toRecord), one major stale-state defect (InputMappingEditor rows not re-synced on external RHF reset), plus five major patches (project prop not forwarded to WorkflowSelector, stale useImperativeHandle closure, blank workflow label for pre-populated selector, key={index} anti-pattern in row list, missing ConfigAccordion wrapper). D1–D9, D11, D12 acceptance criteria pass; D10 is partial. Commit format, security checks pass. All three review lenses ran successfully.

business_review.notes: node-sub-workflow.svg is 32×32, fill='#8B5CF6' on rounded-rect, all interior paths fill='white', no stroke attributes.

business_review.criterion: D2: Promote SUB_WORKFLOW from HIDDEN to ACTION in nodeTemplates

business_review.notes: actionNodes at module level unchanged. useSubWorkflowEnabled inside component body, visibleActionNodes filter, JSX uses visibleActionNodes.map.
Named export, ToolNode pattern: BaseNode + Handle(target,Left) + NodeHeader(SUB_WORKFLOW, title=id) + Handle(source,Right). isConnected from state._meta.is_connected.
Interface and implementation correct. GET v1/workflows/selectable?per_page=12&filters=..., returns response.data ?? response.
Optional getOptions prop added. fetchWorkflowOptions uses const fetcher = getOptions ?? workflowsStore.getWorkflowOptions. No breaking changes.
Props (value, onChange, disabled) correct. add/remove/edit rows all call onChange(toRecord(rows)). Disabled propagated.
workflow_id nullable + required (intentional improvement over spec's nullable-only). input_mapping: Yup.object().optional(). SubWorkflowFormValues exported.

All functional requirements met (registerFields, forwardRef, yupResolver, WorkflowSelector singleValue, InputMappingEditor via Controller, saveData without actors, CommonStateFields+TabFooter, if(!state) guard). Missing: fields not wrapped in ConfigAccordion — every peer tab (TransformTab, CustomTab, ToolTab, IteratorTab) uses ConfigAccordion for its node-specific fields.
Direct import, [NodeTypes.SUB_WORKFLOW]: SubWorkflowTab in nodeConfigPanels, SUB_WORKFLOW in max-w-96 CSS condition.

standards_review.notes: All 6 Story 2 commits follow EPMCDME-11609: Capital sentence format. Verified against the ^(EPMCDME)-(?!0+)\d+:\s[A-Z][a-z]*.* regex in git-workflow.md.
.ai-run/guides/standards/code-quality.md not present in repository; no blocking code-quality standards to check.

No secrets, tokens, or credentials in diff. URL parameters properly encoded via encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(...)). No dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no eval, no injection vectors. Security patterns guide absent; no concrete security issues found.

findings.problem: toRecord uses Object.fromEntries(rows.map(r => [r.key, r.value])): if two rows share the same key, the earlier entry is silently dropped.
findings.impact: The caller receives fewer entries than the user entered — irreversible data loss in input_mapping with no error feedback.
findings.recommendation: Validate for duplicate keys before calling onChange; show a per-row inline error when a duplicate is detected so the user can correct it before the value propagates.

findings.problem: rows is initialised once via useState(() => toRows(value)) and never re-synced when the controlled value prop is externally replaced (e.g. when the parent RHF form is reset to a different input_mapping value).
findings.impact: After an external reset (discard flow, keep-mounted reuse), the editor shows stale key-value rows while RHF's field value holds the correct data — the user sees mappings that do not match what will be saved.
findings.recommendation: Add useEffect(() => { setRows(toRows(value)) }, [value]) with a stable dependency (deep-compare or serialize) so rows is synchronised whenever value is externally replaced.

findings.problem: The project prop is declared in SubWorkflowTabProps and received from ConfigPanel but is never destructured from the component's parameter list and therefore never forwarded to WorkflowSelector.
findings.impact: getSelectableWorkflows is always called with project: undefined, so the dropdown lists selectable workflows from all projects — a user in Project A can silently bind a sub-workflow owned by Project B.
findings.recommendation: Destructure project from the component props alongside the other fields and pass it as the project prop of WorkflowSelector, mirroring the pattern in AssistantTab and ToolTab.

findings.problem: useImperativeHandle deps are [isFormDirty, state, stateId, config, onConfigChange] but saveData closes over validationError and onClearStateError which are absent from the array.
findings.impact: If validationError changes (a new error arrives) without any listed dep changing, the ref's save() call operates on stale validationError === undefined, so the clear-error side effect never fires and the error banner persists after a successful save.
findings.recommendation: Add validationError and onClearStateError to the useImperativeHandle dependency array.

findings.problem: WorkflowSelector is seeded with value={field.value ? [{ id: field.value, name: '' }] : []} — an empty string as the name of the pre-selected workflow.
findings.impact: When editing an existing node, the selected workflow chip renders with a blank label until the user manually interacts with the selector, making the existing configuration appear unconfigured.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) look up the workflow name from the state object (if available) and pass it as name, or (b) pass initialOptions={[{ id: field.value, name: state?.workflow_name ?? field.value }]} so the selector can display the name before options load.

findings.problem: Rows are rendered with key={index}. When a row is deleted from any position except the last, React reuses existing DOM input elements by index.
findings.impact: Deleting a row from the middle causes the wrong DOM input to retain focus and browser-internal state (cursor position, autofill state) for the render cycle, degrading the editing experience.
findings.recommendation: Assign each row a stable unique key on creation (e.g., a uuid or an incrementing counter in state) so React correctly mounts/unmounts the affected input on deletion.

findings.problem: WorkflowSelector and InputMappingEditor Controllers are rendered directly inside the form without a ConfigAccordion wrapper. Every comparable peer tab (TransformTab, CustomTab, ToolTab, IteratorTab) wraps its node-specific fields in <ConfigAccordion title="... Configuration" defaultExpanded={true}>.
findings.impact: Sub-Workflow configuration fields are always fully expanded with no collapsible section, creating an inconsistent UX relative to all other config panels.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the workflow_id and input_mapping Controller blocks in <ConfigAccordion title="Sub-Workflow Configuration" defaultExpanded={true}>...</ConfigAccordion>, matching the pattern in TransformTab and CustomTab.
